Paste these answers into Play Console → App content → Data safety.

## Does your app collect or share any of the required user data types?

**Yes** — but only because the advertising SDK does. The game itself
collects nothing that identifies a person, has no account, no sign-in,
no cloud save and no server of its own.

## Collected by the game

| Data type | Collected | Shared | Purpose | Optional |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| App interactions | Yes | No | Analytics | Yes — a switch in settings |
| Other app performance data | No | No | — | — |
| Device or other IDs | No | No | — | — |

The game records exactly 13 kinds of event and no others. The list is
fixed in `scripts/services/analytics.gd`; anything not on it is dropped
rather than sent, and `tests/test_monetization.gd` asserts that.

- `first_launch`
- `session_start`
- `session_end`
- `tutorial_complete`
- `first_production`
- `first_upgrade`
- `depth_reached`
- `collapse`
- `rewarded_shown`
- `rewarded_completed`
- `iap_started`
- `iap_purchased`
- `iap_failed`

An event may carry only these 8 property keys, none of which can
hold free text from the device or the player:

`depth`, `collapses`, `cores`, `seconds`, `placement`, `product`, `code`, `count`

Plus a random install identifier generated on first launch, the app
version and a timestamp. The identifier is not derived from anything
about the person or the device, and uninstalling deletes it.

**Data is encrypted in transit:** yes (https only).
**Users can request data deletion:** not applicable — nothing is stored
on a server. Uninstalling removes everything.

## Collected by Google AdMob

Rewarded video only, opt-in, never an interstitial. AdMob collects under
its own policies, which typically includes device or advertising IDs, IP
address and app interactions, for advertising and fraud prevention.
Declare per Google's published AdMob data-safety guidance.

Buying the Foreman's Licence removes ads and with them the ad SDK's
collection.

## Collected by Google Play Billing

Purchases are handled entirely by Google Play. The game never sees a
payment detail; it stores one boolean per product, on the device.

Products in this build:

- `foremans_licence` — Foreman's Licence (one-time, non-consumable)
- `foundry_themes` — Foundry Colours (one-time, non-consumable)
